claim_ceiling: Authored candidate specification row only; no observed result, active policy, released case or employment effect.

fields.calculation: `pending`, `reviewed`, `needs resolution`, or `insufficient evidence`, using reviewer discrepancy, transcript uncertainty and administration exceptions. A disagreement of two or more anchor levels follows the predeclared adjudication rule.
fields.display_gate: Withhold affected dimension rating while unresolved or `UNK`. Case/rater generalizability intervals require E04 and are not fabricated for an individual.
fields.interpretation: A disclosure of whether feedback can be read; **not** a probability that the person has an ability.
